scripts.typecheck: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml --profile tools run --rm tools pnpm typecheck:packages
scripts.build: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml --profile tools run --rm tools pnpm build:packages
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml --profile tools run --rm tools pnpm test:integration:internal
scripts.smoke:api: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml --profile tools run --rm tools pnpm smoke:api:internal
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @hcl/web build && pnpm --filter @hcl/api build && pnpm --filter @hcl/worker build
